# Schedule parser fixtures

These are real, public conference schedules, cut down to a few sessions each. The original structure (envelopes, field names, escaping, line endings, timezone blocks) is kept exactly; only the session lists, plus any speakers, rooms and tracks no remaining session references, were removed. Some long abstracts and bios are truncated with `...`. Everything was fetched on **2026-11-09**. There is no attendee data, only public speaker names, bios and avatar URLs. Format notes are in `backend/docs/schedule-formats.md`.

| Fixture | Format | Source URL | What it exercises |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sched-kubecon-na-2025.ics` | Sched iCalendar | https://kccncna2025.sched.com/all.ics | UTC `Z` times, unfolded lines over 75 octets, CRLF, `SUMMARY` = `Title - Name\, Role\, Org & Name\, Org`, `CATEGORIES` used as the track, non-talk rows (`REGISTRATION`, `BREAKS`), a lightning talk with no speakers, a title containing `&` and ` - `. It is byte-identical to `talks-playground/data/kubecon-ics/kccncna2025.ics` (checked against the live export). |
| `pretalx-pyconde-2025.ics` | pretalx iCalendar | https://pretalx.com/pyconde-pydata-2025/schedule/export/schedule.ics | A `VTIMEZONE` plus `DTSTART;TZID=Europe/Berlin`, RFC-folded lines, `SUMMARY` = `Title - Speaker`, no `CATEGORIES`, so there is no track. |
| `sessionize-kotlinconf-2026-all.json` | Sessionize `view/All` | https://sessionize.com/api/v2/2r0suvtg/view/All | UTC `Z` times, speakers and categories referenced by id, multi-speaker workshops, service sessions (Registration, Coffee Break) with GUID ids and no speakers. The event id comes from `JetBrains/kotlinconf-app` `backend/src/main/resources/application.yaml`. |
| `sessionize-aiengineer-2025-all-floating.json` | Sessionize `view/All` | https://sessionize.com/api/v2/w3hd2z8a/view/All | **Floating local times** (`2025-06-03T09:00:00`, no offset) and an empty `categories` list. The venue is San Francisco, so the zone is `America/Los_Angeles`, but the payload never says so. The event id comes from `PallavAg/aiengineer-schedule` README. |
| `pretalx-pyconde-2025-schedule.json` | pretalx frab-compatible JSON | https://pretalx.com/pyconde-pydata-2025/schedule/export/schedule.json | Day → room → talk nesting, offset-aware `date`/`end`, `persons[].public_name`, `track` string, `conference.time_zone_name`. Only the first day and first 2 rooms are kept, 3 talks each. |
| `frab-fosdem-2025-schedule.xml` | frab/Pentabarf XML | https://fosdem.org/2025/schedule/xml | Top-level `<tracks>`, `<day><room><event>` nesting, `date` + `duration` with no end time, `<persons><person>`, HTML-escaped `<abstract>`. Only the first day and first 2 rooms are kept, 3 events each. It was re-serialized with stdlib `ElementTree`, so indentation differs from the original. |
| `html-devopsdays-chicago-2025-program.html` | Plain HTML agenda (LLM fallback) | https://devopsdays.org/events/2025-chicago/program | The timezone is stated only in prose ("All times are in US Central Time"), the date only in a day header, `Speaker - Title` in link text, breaks/sponsor/lunch rows, a 5-talk "Ignites" block in one slot, and parallel open-space and workshop rows. The nav, sponsor logos, footer and scripts were removed. The full day is kept (about 12 talks) because the parallel-slot rows sit in the afternoon. |

The scripts that trimmed these were throwaway and are not committed. To refresh a fixture, re-fetch the URL and cut it down by hand the same way.
